sources.title: Gemma model fine-tuning - Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning a generative artificial intelligence (AI) model such as Gemma modifies the behavior of the model. You typically fine-tune Gemma with the intent of improving its performance on a specific task or domain, or to better fulfill a role, such as customer service.
